scope: GNOME Wayland headless compositor capability probe

commands.assertions: GNOME Shell 46.0 started Mutter 46.2 as a Wayland display server and created wayland-0, but no virtual monitor was available and no user session/display surface was exposed before bounded shutdown.
Mutter reported that the backend does not support creating virtual monitors.

limitations: A headless compositor without a monitor cannot satisfy NAT-06 capture/input acceptance; no Device Control helper journey was run against it. The GNOME support row remains not_run.
